answer: The oasis ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own knoll record, and its own share of the hollow quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1665 identities would post 890 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
